## Holocene fire events

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/worked_examples/fig_fire_event_detection_workflow.pdf', page = 1)
```

**From a charcoal peak to an accepted event**, with every record's settings and counts.

```{r}
read_output('holocene_fire_source_settings.csv') |>
  transmute(Site = site, Lake = lake, Engine = engine, Chronology = chronology,
    `Interpolation (yr)` = interpolation_years, `Background (yr)` = smoothing_years,
    Threshold = threshold_probability, `Threshold type` = threshold_type, Background = background_method,
    `Count test p` = minimum_count_probability, `Count window (yr)` = minimum_count_window_years) |>
  show_table('fire_detection_settings', caption = '**Detection settings of the four records.**')
read_output('fire_noca_tapas_sensitivity.csv') |>
  transmute(Setting = setting, `Background (yr)` = smoothing, `Interpolation (yr)` = yrInterp,
    Threshold = threshold, `Accepted events` = n_sig) |>
  show_table('noca_threshold_sensitivity', caption = '**Panther Potholes: events under alternative settings.**')
```

## CharAnalysis reproduction of Walsh et al. (2017)

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/worked_examples/fig_fire_event_detection_workflow.pdf', page = 3)
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/fig_walsh_charanalysis_reproduction.pdf', page = 1:3)
```

**CharAnalysis R 2.0.3 against the published totals and the tapas catalog**, and the CharAnalysis
series for each MORA record.

```{r}
read_output('walsh_charanalysis_table3_audit.csv') |>
  transmute(Lake = lake, `CharAnalysis R 2.0.3` = official_r_episodes, Published = published_total_episodes,
    Difference = difference, Interpretation = interpretation) |>
  show_table('charanalysis_reproduction', caption = '**CharAnalysis R against Walsh et al. (2017), Table 3.**')
```

## Modern fire assignment of the survey plots

MORA plots are burned when a mapped 1987–2017 disturbance overlaps them; NOCA plots follow the
Wilson (2024) assignment rule.

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/NOCA_fire_map_Wilson2024_PaleoACES.pdf')
read_output('NOCA_fire_Wilson2024_comparison.csv') |>
  count(`Plot universe` = universe_status, `PaleoACES burned` = paleoaces_burnt, `Wilson burned` = wilson_burnt,
    Discrepancy = assignment_discrepancy, name = 'Plots') |>
  show_table('noca_fire_vs_wilson', caption = '**NOCA fire assignment against Wilson (2024).**')
```
